verdict.rationale: Lever documents its own Career Site Builder: a no-code, template-based site that the hiring team brands with its company logo, colors and font. The evidence never says the site runs on the customer's own domain, or that jobs publish to it automatically from the ATS, so only the branding and no-engineering parts are shown. Missing for 10: custom-domain hosting, documented automatic job publishing from the ATS to the careers page, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I get a hosted, branded careers page on my own domain — jobs publish to it straight from the ATS with no engineering work

citations.quote: Anyone on your hiring team can craft a compelling career site in minutes — no design or coding experience necessary.
Add your company logo, color scheme, and primary font
Take advantage of out-of-the-box templates. Point-and-click edits, no coding required.
